packageRules.description: npm dependencies in the root manifest follow core, not Renovate. Nested manifests under integrationTests/ stay managed.

This rule only enables automerge for actions in selected pull-request test workflows. Repository rules remain responsible for required checks and approval; release, scheduled, and other workflows stay human-reviewed.
Majors are merged by a human.
A 0.x release conveys breaking changes in its minor, which Renovate still classifies as `minor`.

Compiled addons, the at-rest/wire encoders, and the SQL engine are merged by a human. Only the node images are reachable today, since the root manifest is disabled above; the rest are listed so this file and harper's stay one policy.
rocksdb-js is proposed by its own release workflow, not by Renovate.
